description: Evals for the check-file-size preToolUse hook (matcher: read)

evals.name: small-file
evals.reason: File under threshold — delegation overhead not worth it

evals.name: boundary-exact-350
evals.reason: Exactly at threshold (<=350) — should not block

evals.name: just-over-threshold
evals.reason: One line over threshold — should block

evals.name: large-file
evals.reason: Well over threshold — clear delegation candidate

evals.name: very-large-file
evals.reason: Very large file — blocked regardless of extension

evals.name: empty-file
evals.reason: Empty file — nothing to delegate

evals.name: targeted-read-offset
evals.reason: Offset set — targeted read, allow through

evals.name: targeted-read-limit
evals.reason: Limit set — targeted read, allow through

evals.name: targeted-read-both
evals.reason: Both offset and limit — definitely a targeted read

evals.name: nonexistent-file
evals.reason: File doesn't exist — let read handle the error

evals.name: empty-filepath
evals.reason: Empty path — pass through

evals.name: missing-filepath-field
evals.reason: No path field — pass through gracefully

evals.name: offset-zero
evals.reason: offset:0 treated as targeted — known bypass, documenting behavior

evals.name: limit-zero
evals.reason: limit:0 treated as targeted — known bypass, documenting behavior

evals.name: env-override-lower
evals.reason: KIRUNT_MIN_LINES=200 overrides default — 250-line file should block

evals.name: env-override-higher
evals.reason: KIRUNT_MIN_LINES=500 overrides default — 351-line file should be allowed

evals.name: env-non-numeric-fallback
evals.reason: Non-numeric KIRUNT_MIN_LINES falls back to 350 — 351-line file blocked

evals.name: bulk-reader-disabled-bypasses-large-file
evals.reason: KIRUNT_ENABLE_BULK_READER=false disables blocking too — no delegation path to redirect to

evals.name: bulk-reader-disabled-bypasses-huge-file
evals.reason: Disabled flag bypasses even very large files

evals.name: directory-mode-not-gated
evals.reason: Directory mode reads are out of scope for this hook

evals.name: multi-op-second-offending
evals.reason: Batched read where the second operation is a large untargeted file — block the whole call

evals.name: v3-large-file
evals.reason: CLI V3 read_file event — large untargeted read should block

evals.name: v3-small-file
evals.reason: CLI V3 read_file event — file under threshold is allowed

evals.name: v3-targeted-offset
evals.reason: CLI V3 read_file event — offset makes it a targeted read

evals.name: v3-targeted-limit
evals.reason: CLI V3 read_file event — limit makes it a targeted read

evals.name: v3-relative-path
evals.reason: CLI V3 events use paths relative to cwd — resolve before checking size

evals.name: v3-list-directory-not-gated
evals.reason: The read matcher covers list_directory too, but only read_file is gated

evals.name: v3-missing-path
evals.reason: Malformed V3 read event with no path passes through gracefully
